title: Qualify original scientific C03 cross-family aggregate T1
commitMessage: feat: qualify cross-family scientific aggregate and original C03 T1

contribution.summary: Qualify original C03 T1 with an all-or-none bounded scientific facade composing seven outcomes across S01 Euclidean, S02 direct DFT/linear convolution, and S03 uniform-series kernels. Observe one compiled missing-API RED, 56 GREEN, 701 retained scientific tests, four Math regressions and five SHA-equal preview.11 NuGet-only consumers. Close parent T1 R/G/V and T1 only; leave C03-T2, parent C03, M6-W02 and M6 unfinished.
contribution.value: Expose typed fail-closed cross-family composition without leaking earlier successful calculations after a later family refuses. Preserve each qualified direct kernel's Cartesian, binary64, discrete-sample and time-interval budgets. No implicit units, geodesy, FFT, cross-family error theorem, forecasting or public package/downstream adoption.
